entities.name: RRC Reconfiguration
entities.description: Procedure to modify an RRC connection, including establishing/modifying/releasing RBs/BH RLC channels, performing reconfiguration with sync, managing measurements, SCells, cell groups, conditional handover, and conditional PSCell configurations. May transfer NAS dedicated information.

entities.name: RRCReconfiguration
entities.description: Message sent by Network to UE to initiate RRC reconfiguration procedure.

entities.name: RRCReconfigurationComplete
entities.description: Message sent by UE to Network upon successful RRC reconfiguration.

entities.name: RRC connection re-establishment
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE in case of RRC reconfiguration failure.

entities.name: Reconfiguration with sync and security key refresh
entities.description: Condition involving RA to PCell/PSCell, MAC reset, security refresh, and RLC/PDCP re-establishment triggered by explicit L2 indicators.

entities.name: Reconfiguration with sync without security key refresh
entities.description: Condition involving RA to PCell/PSCell, MAC reset, RLC re-establishment, and PDCP data recovery for AM DRB/MRB triggered by explicit L2 indicators.

entities.name: DAPS reconfiguration with sync and security key refresh
entities.description: Condition for DAPS involving RA to target PCell, target MAC establishment, security refresh, and RLC/PDCP handling for non-DAPS/DAPS bearers and SRBs.

entities.name: DAPS reconfiguration with sync without security key refresh
entities.description: Condition for DAPS involving RA to target PCell, target MAC establishment, and RLC/PDCP handling for non-DAPS/DAPS bearers and SRBs without security refresh.

entities.name: NAS dedicated information transfer
entities.description: Property allowing transfer of NAS dedicated information from Network to UE during RRC reconfiguration.

relations.description: RRC reconfiguration procedure includes sending RRCReconfiguration message.
Successful RRC reconfiguration includes sending RRCReconfigurationComplete message.
Failed RRC reconfiguration may trigger RRC connection re-establishment procedure.
RRC reconfiguration procedure enables transfer of NAS dedicated information.
RRC reconfiguration includes reconfiguration with sync and security key refresh as a case.
RRC reconfiguration includes reconfiguration with sync without security key refresh as a case.
RRC reconfiguration includes DAPS reconfiguration with sync and security key refresh as a case.
RRC reconfiguration includes DAPS reconfiguration with sync without security key refresh as a case.
Reconfiguration with sync and security key refresh includes DAPS-specific handling.
Reconfiguration with sync without security key refresh includes DAPS-specific handling.
